evidence: products must contain electrical or mechanical components that can be replaced or upgraded

evidence: To qualify for Amazon Renewed, you must have experience selling repaired or refurbished products

claim: Sellers complete the Renewed application to demonstrate they can meet Amazon's quality policy.
evidence: Complete the Amazon Renewed application to demonstrate you can meet our quality policy.

claim: Application images should show a sample product from all sides, the product packaging and accessories showing the brand, with the screen on if it has one.
evidence: If the product has a screen, include a picture with the screen on.

claim: Invoices must be itemized with brand and model information that can be validated online.

claim: The application requires itemized invoices showing at least $50,000 in qualifying refurbished purchases ($2.5 million for Apple-branded items) in the previous 90 days, or 180 days for Home, Tools, Kitchen, or Lawn & Garden products.

verifier_note: Source attaches a 90-day window (180 days for Home, Tools, Kitchen, Lawn & Garden) and a $2.5M Apple threshold; claim and page sentences narrowed accordingly.

evidence: Refurbisher: You source, inspect, test, and cosmetically restore used products without actually opening the device.

claim: Application images must show Renewed's cosmetic grade of Excellent condition.
